questions.question: What is the area (in sq cm) of a rectangle, if its diagonal is 25 cm and one of its sides is 24 cm?
questions.solution:
Let the other side be x cm.

Length of diagonal = √(x² + 24²) cm = 25 cm

⇒ x² + 24² = 25²

⇒ x² = 625 – 576 = 49

⇒ x = 7

∴ Area of the rectangle = 7 cm × 24 cm = 168 cm²

questions.question: What is the value of tan 6° tan 36° tan 84° tan 54° tan 45°?
questions.solution:
**Formulae Used:**

tan (90° - A°) = cot A

cot A = 1/tan A

**Calculation:**

tan 6° tan 36° tan 84° tan 54° tan 45°

= tan 6° tan 36° tan (90 - 6)° tan (90 – 36)° tan 45°

= tan 6° tan 36° cot 6° cot 36° tan 45°

= tan 6° × tan 36° × (1)/(tan 6) × (1)/(tan 36) × tan 45°

= 1

questions.question: A vendor buys 6 bananas for Rs. 25 and sells them at 3 for Rs. 20. What is his profit percentage?
questions.solution:
Cost price of 6 bananas = Rs. 25

Selling price of 3 bananas = Rs. 20

Selling price of 6 bananas = Rs. 20 × 2 = Rs. 40

∴ Profit % = (Rs. 40 – Rs. 25)/Rs. 25 × 100% = 60%

questions.question: Two laborers A and B are paid a total of Rs. 650 per day. If A is paid 160 percent of what is paid to B, how much (in Rs) is B paid?
questions.solution:
Let the wages of A and B be Rs. x and Rs. y respectively.

Since A is paid 160% of what B is paid,

⇒ (x/y) × 100 = 160

⇒ x = 160y/100 = 8y/5 ---(1)

Total wage = Rs. x + Rs. y = Rs. (8y/5) + y {Using (1)} = Rs. 13y/5 = Rs. 650 (given)

⇒ y = 650 × 5/13 = 250

∴ B is paid Rs. 250.

What number should be added to each of the numbers 55, 100, 65 and 116, so that the resulting numbers are in continued proportion?
questions.solution:
Let x be added to each number i.e. 55, 100, 65 and 116, such that the resulting numbers are in continued proportion.

⇒ (55 + x) : (100 + x) = (65 + x) : (116 + x)

⇒ (55 + x) (116 + x) = (65 + x) (100 + x)

⇒ x² + 171x + 6380 = x² + 165x + 6500

⇒ 6x = 120

⇒ x = 20

∴ 20 must be added to each number.

questions.question: ax + 5y = 8 has slope of -4/3. What is the value of a?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

ax + 5y = 8

**Calculation:**

ax + 5y = 8

⇒ y = -ax/5 + 8/5

Comparing it with y = mx + c, where m = Slope

So, m = -a/5

⇒ Slope = -a/5 = -4/3 (given)

⇒ a/5 = 4/3

∴ a = 20/3

questions.question: Asif is twice as good a workman as Bashir and together they finish a piece of work in 30 days. In how many days will Asif alone finish the work?
questions.solution:
Let work done by Bashir in 1 day be x

Work done by Asif in 1 day = 2x

Work done by both in 1 day = 3x = 1/30 (given)

⇒ x = 1/90

Work done by Asif in 1 day = 2/90 = 1/45

∴ Time taken by Asif to finish the work alone = 45 days

questions.question: What is the reflection of the point (-1, 3) in the line x = -4?
questions.solution:
Let the reflected point be (x, y).

Then the midpoint of (-1, 3) and (x, y) i.e. [(x-1)/2, (y+3)/2] must lie on the line x = -4.

⇒ (x – 1) / 2 = -4

⇒ x = -8 + 1 = -7

Since the line joining the original and the reflected point in perpendicular to x = -4, hence its slope will be equal to 0.

⇒ [y – 3]/[(-7) – (-1)] = 0

⇒ y – 3 = 0

⇒ y = 3

∴ The reflected point is (-7, 3).

questions.question: A batsman makes a score of 111 runs in the 10th match and thus increases his average runs per match by 5. What will be his average after the 10th match?
questions.solution:
Let average runs be x.

Total runs in 9 matches = 9x

Average runs after 10th match = (9x + 111)/10 = x + 5 (given)

⇒ 9x + 111 = 10x + 50)

⇒ x = 61

∴ Average after 10th match = 61 + 5 = 66

questions.question: PQ is the chord of a circle whose centre is O. ROS is a line segment originating from a point R on the circle that intersect PQ produced at point S such that QS = OR. If ∠QSR = 30°, then what is the value (in degrees)of POR?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/60dbf3839771b995214887cbc0366996aceaa063c545a8713672cf0b8898fdc2.png] 

Join OP and OQ

Since OQ = OP = OR (radius)

⇒ QS = OR = OQ

⇒ ∠QOS = ∠QSO = 30°

In triangle SQO,

⇒ ∠QOS + ∠QSO + ∠SQO = 180°

⇒ ∠SQO = 120°

In triangle POQ,

OP = OQ (both are radius)

⇒ ∠OQP = ∠QPO = 180° - 120° = 60°

∠QPO + ∠POQ = ∠OQS (Exterior angle property)

⇒ ∠QPO + ∠POQ = 120°

⇒ ∠POQ = 120° - ∠QPO = 120° - 60° = 60°

⇒ ∠POS = 60° + 30° = 90°

∴ ∠POR = 180° - ∠POS = 90°

questions.question: A shopkeeper marks up his wares by 60% and offers 25% discount. What will be the selling price (in Rs) if the cost price is Rs. 1600?
questions.solution:
Cost price = Rs. 1600

List price = Rs. 1600 + Rs. 1600 × 60/100 = Rs. 1600 + Rs. 960 = Rs. 2560

Discount = Rs. 2560 × 25/100 = Rs. 640

∴ Selling price = Rs. 2560 – Rs. 640 = Rs. 1920

If (x – 2)² + (y + 3)² + (z – 15)² = 0, then what is the value of x + y + z – 5
questions.solution:
(x – 2)² + (y + 3)² + (z – 15)² = 0

Since all the three terms are positive

Their sum can be 0 only when all the 3 terms are 0

⇒ x – 2 = 0; y + 3 = 0; z – 15 = 0

⇒ x = 2; y = -3; z = 15

∴ x + y + z – 5 = 2 – 3 + 15 – 5 = 9

questions.question: The two equal sides of an isosceles triangle is 20 cm each and the third side is 30 cm. What is the area (in cm²) of the triangle?
questions.solution:
Semi perimeter = (20 + 20 + 30)/2 cm = 35 cm

Using Heron’s formula,

∴ Area = √[35(35 – 20)(35 – 20)(35 – 30)] = 75√7

questions.question: A man travelled a distance of 60 km in 7 hours. He travelled partly on foot @ 6 km/hr and partly on bicycle @ 12 km/hr. What is the distance (in kms) travelled on foot?
questions.solution:
Let the man travel x km on foot and y km on a bicycle.

Total distance travelled = x + y km = 60 km (given)

⇒ x + y = 60 ----(1)

Duration for which man travelled on foot = x km ÷ 6 km/hr = x/6 hrs

Duration for which man travelled on bicycle = y km ÷ 12 km/hr = y/12 hrs

Total travelling time = x/6 + y/12 hrs = 7 hrs (given)

⇒ (2x + y)/12 = 7

⇒ 2x + y = 84 ----(2)

Subtracting (1) from (2), we get

⇒ x = 24

∴ The man travelled 24 km on foot.

questions.question: The compound interest earned in two years at 12% per annum is Rs 10176. What is the sum (in Rs) invested?
questions.solution:
Let invested sum be Rs. P.

Interest rate, r = 12/100 = 0.12

Value of investment after 2 years = Rs. P + 10176

Using compound interest formula,

A = P (1 + r/n)ⁿt

⇒ P + 10176 = P (1 + 0.12)²

⇒ P + 10176 = 1.2544P

⇒ 0.2555P = 10176

⇒ P = 40000

∴ Sum invested = Rs. 40000

questions.question: What is the sum of the first 11 terms of an arithmetic progression if the 4th term is 11 and the 7th term is -4?
questions.solution:
Let the first term be a and the common difference be r.

a₄ = a + (4 – 1) r

⇒ a + 3r = 11 ------ (1)

a₇ = a + (7 – 1) r 

⇒ a + 6r = -4 ------ (2)

Subtracting (1) from (2), we get

3r = -15

r = -5

a = 11 – 3 × (-5) = 26

Sum of first 11 terms = 11/2 [2 × 26 + (11 – 1) × (-5)] = 11

**∴ The sum of the first 11 term is 11**

questions.question: D and E are points on side AB and AC of ΔABC. DE is parallel to BC. If AD : DB = 2 : 5 and area of ΔABC is 98 cm sq, what is the area (in sq cm) of quadrilateral BDEC?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**AD : DB = 2 : 5

So, AB = 7a

Area of ΔABC = 7²a

⇒ 7²a = 98 

⇒ a = 2

Area of quad BDEC = 7²a - 2²a

= 45a

= 90

**__Solution:__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/618ae136594100412bd26040eca5c715a4f106c3ebfd49ffe84050e1e6ef4b5f.png] 

Since DE is parallel to BC.

⇒ ∠ABP = ∠ADQ ---- (1)

AD : DB = 2 : 5

⇒ DB/AD = 5/2

⇒ 1 + DB/AD = 1 + 5/2

⇒ (AD + DB)/AD = 7/2

⇒ AB/AD = 7/2 ---- (2)

In ΔABC and ΔADE

∠BAC = ∠DAE (common angle)

∠ABC = ∠ADE (corresponding angles) {using (1)}

∠ACB = ∠AED (corresponding angles)

⇒ ΔABC ~ ΔADE (by AAA)

⇒ AB/AD = BC/DE = 7/2 {using (2)}

⇒ DE = 2BC/7 ---- (3)

In ΔABP and ΔADQ

∠BAP = ∠DAQ (common angle)

∠ABC = ∠ADE (corresponding angles) {using (1)}

∠APB = ∠AQD = 90ᵒ

⇒ ΔABP ~ ΔADQ (by AAA)

⇒ AB/AD = AQ/AP = 7/2 {using (2)}

⇒ AQ = 2AP/7 ---- (4)

Area of ΔABC = 98 cm²

Area of ΔADE = 1/2 × DE × AQ = 1/2 × 2BC/7 × 2AP/7 = 4/49 × 1/2 × BC × AP = 4/49 × Area of ΔABC = 4/49 × 98 cm² = 8 cm²

∴ Area of BDEC = 98 – 8 cm² = 90 cm²
